aero_backend.name: TANGENT_WEDGE_SHOCK_EXPANSION
aero_backend.model_version: TANGENT_WEDGE_SHOCK_EXPANSION | offdesign_aero_v7-1.0 mode=P2 friction=none base=none (pressure only)
aero_backend.coefficients: pressure-only CL and CD_pressure on Sref; NOT total drag (no friction, no base drag)
aero_backend.invalid_states: no attached weak shock / subsonic / Prandtl-Meyer vacuum / strip fold-back -> model_valid=false, no silent fallback
aero_backend.reference_source: configs/mission_1200s.yaml model.reference_area_m2; v7 database builder reference

flight_grid.note: primary-mission screening only; the full support domain M[3.5,9.25] alpha[-2,12] is NOT covered by this run

ranking.metric: L_over_D = CL / CD_pressure at fixed alpha

gates.lift_floor_source: results/fixed_geometry_baselines/comparison.json operating_condition_envelope.CL_actual.p5 (all feasible fixed baselines, 0.5 s samples)
gates.volume_thickness_screen: EXPLORATORY: volume_full >= 0.85*G42 and grid_thickness_max >= 0.5*G42 (src/mission_v6 stage2 common.py scenario definition; research assumption, not an engineering requirement)

ranking.low_lift_note: candidates below the floor are kept in all_candidate_scores.csv with flag LOW_LIFT; they are never ranked

controls.baseline: G42 (if it already is in Top5 it is not duplicated)
controls.diversity: valid gate-passing candidate maximizing min normalized distance to the Top5 over [Ma_design, volume ratio, thickness ratio, a1,a2,b1,b2,d1,a_x]

equal_lift.targets_source: mission envelope CL_actual p5 / mid / p95 (comparison.json)
equal_lift.interpolation: PCHIP in alpha inside the bracket only, no extrapolation

geometry_generation.reason: existing audited pool already spans many design Mach families; new teacher generation deferred (budget 0 in this run)
geometry_generation.budget_note: no parallel MATLAB, no use of CFD processes

cad.unit_policy: program length unit = 1 m (audit: 'm under existing V5 1 metre/program-unit assumption; physical scale unconfirmed'); STEP written in mm (x1000)
